title: My latest Mall world dream
content: its my first time posting here so i thought id start with my most recent one. so usually im traveling the train to the resort but this time i spawned at the resort. im in a spacious, posh suite with soft carpet living room, anything you need is right there such as towels, snacks,waters etc like any hotel with amenities. and i always get a room with a jacuzzi built in the ground, you can control it with a remote. There are alot of windows and I prefer to shut them and close the blinds and curtains for privacy. in this hotel, theres a communal kitchen area that for some reason people pass through from their rooms and sometimes they can pass through your room too. i went straight to the jacuzzi after settling in like I normally do when i spawn here and then I realized the people around me were excited for some reason. especially this one girl, she was an athletic built tall brunette with a green bikini and she was hurrying around the room in the main area and then she walked over to me and pulled me over with her, she was talking happily and leading me to a larger jacuzzi with bench type seating. After soaking for awhile i wanted to change and shower, but changing is kinda difficult here, every thing feels heavy so I decided to shower with some of my clothes still on. Then I noticed in the bathroom theres also a large bathtub with jets - designed like a huge round clam, it would make someone feel like venus! then I remember being in the kitchen area looking at this blonde girl who also with me and the brunette, i was asking if we were staying another night because we had plenty of food left. they all looked at each other and laughed which i took for a yeah why not. and then we were at the steep beach on a boat and the waves were going crazy like 10 feet into the air so a rescue helicopter pulled up and there was a floating mat that we were supposed to jump into to get to the helicopter. The brunette jumped first and then it was my turn to jump and i was afraid that I might not make it or overshot and fall out of the other side of the helicopter but I noticed that the other side was sealed off and I asked them to pull in a little closer so they got as close as they could and i felt someone behind me waiting so i decided to jump and as soon as i leapt into the helicopter, i woke up . It was about 4am and took me awhile to fall back asleep, but i didnt dream anymore after that
